title: Exceptional
text: It has been the best massage I have ever had thanks to Chelo. I chose the place by chance, but the experience turned out to be super satisfying. My back and neck were tense and I chose a deep tissue massage. I found Chelo to be a very expert person and a great professional; she removed my knots and relaxed my back and other muscles. Thank you so much for everything, the place is highly recommended.
author: silviavK4898UH

title: Total relaxation

title: Quite simply, excellent
text: I was recently as it was one of the first centers that came out to me when I looked for massage centers in Granada, and it was precisely chance that made me find this wonderful place. From the moment you enter they make you feel welcome, offer you water and treat you sweetly. Attentive staff, careful with every act and infinitely effective, I had not a single complaint in everything about the service or anything else. I'll be right back.
author: Getaway62242697798

title: I always come back (and that says it all!)
text:
